body:
## Pull request overview

Adds automated tests, Storybook JSON stories, and console/kitchen-sink demos to document and validate the new ListView/DetailView plugins and the enhanced Dashboard/Kanban/Chatbot components introduced in PR #379.

**Changes:**
- Added/expanded Vitest + React Testing Library suites for ListView, DetailView, DashboardGridLayout, KanbanEnhanced, and ChatbotEnhanced.
- Added Storybook JSON stories for ListView/DetailView plus additional “enhanced feature” variants for Dashboard/Kanban/Chatbot.
- Wired plugins into the console app and added demo pages/navigation in the kitchen-sink example; cleaned unused imports/vars in several plugin files.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 18 out of 18 changed files in this pull request and generated 13 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |

| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Removes unused imports; adjusts sort field state initialization. |

This story variant sets `enableMarkdown`, but the schema `type` is `chatbot` (basic chatbot). Markdown/file-upload support lives under the `chatbot-enhanced` registration, so switch `type` to `chatbot-enhanced` to demonstrate these features.
```suggestion
    type: 'chatbot-enhanced',
```

`editMode` state (and `setEditMode`) was removed, but `handleEdit` still calls `setEditMode(true)`, which will cause a compile/runtime error. Either reintroduce the `editMode` state, or remove the fallback branch that enters edit mode (and rely on `onEdit`/`schema.editUrl`).

This assertion will fail: `ListView` only writes the view to localStorage inside `handleViewChange`, not on initial render. Update the test to trigger a view change (e.g., click the ViewSwitcher item) and then assert `localStorage.setItem` (or the stored value) was updated, or change the component behavior if you intend to persist the initial view on mount.

This test doesn't validate behavior (it only checks the callback is defined). Since the ViewSwitcher exposes `aria-label`s (e.g. "List"), trigger an actual view change and assert `onViewChange` is called with the expected view.

`DashboardGridLayout` is registered as `type: 'dashboard-grid'` (see `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx`), but this story uses `type: 'dashboard'` plus `enableGridLayout`/`persistLayout` fields that `DashboardRenderer` doesn't consume. Switch to `type: 'dashboard-grid'` (and `persistLayoutKey`) if you want to demonstrate the editable grid layout.
```suggestion
    type: 'dashboard-grid',
    name: 'sales_dashboard',
    title: 'Sales Analytics Dashboard',
    persistLayoutKey: 'sales_dashboard_layout',
```

This story variant sets `enableVirtualScrolling`, but the schema `type` is `kanban` (which renders `KanbanImpl`). The enhanced implementation is registered as `type: 'kanban-enhanced'`, so these props will be ignored unless you switch the `type`.
```suggestion
    type: 'kanban-enhanced',
```

`ChatbotEnhanced`'s send button is icon-only and currently has no accessible name, so `getByRole('button', { name: /send/i })` won't find it in the DOM and these tests will fail. Prefer adding an `aria-label` (e.g. "Send message") to the send button in the component, then query by that label in tests.
```suggestion
    const sendButton = screen.getByRole('button');
```

`ChatbotEnhanced` always calls `onSendMessage(message, selectedFiles)` where `selectedFiles` is an array (empty by default), not `undefined`. These expectations should be updated to match the actual second argument (`[]`), or the component should be changed to pass `undefined` when no files are selected.

The file-upload button is icon-only and has no accessible name, so querying it by `{ name: /attach/i }` will fail. Either add an `aria-label` (recommended for accessibility) or adjust the test to use a stable selector/testid.
```suggestion
    const fileButton = screen.getByTestId('file-upload-button');
```
